sloka: अलङ्कृतमिवात्मानमादर्शतलसंस्थितम् ।स तं सस्मितमाभाष्य पुत्रं पुत्रवतां वरः ॥२-३-३८॥
transliteration: alaṅkṛtamivātmānamādarśatalasaṁsthitam ।sa taṁ sasmitamābhāṣya putraṁ putravatāṁ varaḥ ॥2-3-38॥

translations.english: The best among fathers, he (Dasaratha) said these words to his son with a smile, like Kasyapa addressing Devendra.
